programme.title: Žogarija
programme.desc: Žogarija je projekt, ki uteleša eno naših najpomembnejših prepričanj – da šport lahko izboljša kakovost življenja mladih. Žogarija: harmonija generacij je serija oddaj, ki skozi pristne zgodbe in pogovore povezuje otroke, starše in stare starše. Vsaka oddaja prikazuje medgeneracijsko sodelovanje, igre, ustvarjalnost in vrednote družine v središču lokalnega dogajanja. Gre za toplo, življenjsko serijo, ki spodbuja povezanost in aktivno skupnost.

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Aaron Wise
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: School of Golf: Chapter 22: Right Or Rubbish
programme.desc: School of Golf (Sports). Class is in session with Martin Hall, an award-winning golf teacher who has taught several players on the PGA Tour, Champions Tour and LPGA Tour. Each week his unique teaching style is on display with tips and drills utilizing an in-studio golf simulator. Joined by co-host and former «Big Break» champion Blair O'Neal, Martin also answers plenty of viewer emails and incorporates other forms of social media to help drive the show's content

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Pardon the Interruption
programme.desc: Pardon the Interruption (Sports). The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day

programme.title: ⋗ Hot Stove
programme.desc: Hot Stove (Sports). Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the «Hot Stove» and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others

programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk: Final Show
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Philly Special
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: Pour cette 112e édition de Liège-Bastogne-Liège, le parcours de la "Doyenne" est quelque peu modifié par rapport à l'année dernière, tout en conservant onze côtes répertoriées. programme.title: ⋗ Hot Stove
programme.desc: Hot Stove (Sports). Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the «Hot Stove» and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others

programme.title: ⋗ Intentional Talk: Final Show
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: NFL Fantasy Live
programme.desc: NFL Fantasy Live (Sports). Millions of NFL fans live in a fantasy world where survival depends on successfully navigating the twists and turns of a grueling season. After all, relying on a second-string quarterback or an untested wide receiver to come up big is usually foolhardy. Avoiding such predicaments takes plenty of preparation, and that's where «NFL Fantasy Live» comes into play. Host Marcas Grant provides the advice and analysis fantasy fans need to make winning lineup decisions. And being armed with the latest player updates, stats and trends goes a long way toward turning fantasies into championships

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Get Up
programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: UCI Track WC
programme.desc: Vive lo más emocionante del Campeonato Mundial de Ciclismo en Pista Tissot UCI 2026. Campeones olímpicos y mundiales de la UCI estarán entre las estrellas internacionales que disputarán la competencia. El Campeonato Mundial de Ciclismo en Pista Tissot UCI es el evento anual más importante de la UCI para el ciclismo en pista. En total, se disputan 22 títulos de Campeón Mundial UCI: 11 para hombres y 11 para mujeres.

programme.title: DCSHA
programme.desc: Un pograma que aborda y analiza los hechos más destacados del mundo del ciclismo. A través del espacio, el público amante del deporte podrá informarse sobre competencias, eventos, carreras y mucho más junto a un equipo de expertos.

programme.title: ONE
programme.desc: Toda la acción y el espectáculo de la franquicia One Champioship, con origen en Singapur. La mayor franquicia de deportes de contacto del mundo, disfruta de los enfrentamientos de MMA, muay thai y kickboxing.

programme.title: Eneco Tour Women
programme.desc: Vive toda la emoción de las carreras femeninas que son parte del Eneco Tour en su edición del 2026. Disfruta de la adrenalina de la competencia y conoce a los talentos que se presentan para llevarse el título.

programme.title: Eneco Tour Women
programme.desc: Vive toda la emoción de las carreras femeninas que son parte del Eneco Tour en su edición del 2026. Disfruta de la adrenalina de la competencia y conoce a los talentos que se presentan para llevarse el título.

programme.title: EuroLeague
programme.desc: Vive las emociones de los partidos de la 27º edición de la EuroLiga de básquet, la máxima competición de clubes de Europa. El torneo reúne a la élite del baloncesto masculino europeo y cuenta con 20 equipos participantes, que disputan el título bajo un sistema de liga con partidos de ida y vuelta.

programme.title: Hilos
programme.desc: Juan Pablo Varsky recorre los perfiles e historias de las grandes figuras del deporte mundial.

programme.title: Liga de Portugal
programme.desc: Vive los partidos de la 93º edición de la Primeira Liga de fútbol de Portugal. El torneo es organizado por la Liga Portuguesa de Fútbol Profesional y los amantes del deporte podrán disfrutar de los encuentros más emocionantes con los conjuntos de mayor nivel en el ámbito nacional y profesional.

programme.title: Especial Valentina Roa
programme.desc: Programa dedicado a repasar la trayectoria, logros e historia de vida de Valentina Roa Sánchez, la ciclista colombiana que se ha convertido en la máxima referente del downhill (descenso en ciclismo de montaña) en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: Torneo Regional del NOA
programme.desc: Vive toda la emoción de los partidos de rugby del Torneo Regional del NOA en su edición del 2026. Disfruta de los enfrentamientos entre los equipos que se presentan y conoce a los talentos que participan para llevarse el título.

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Philly Special
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Aaron Wise
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: School of Golf: Chapter 22: Right Or Rubbish
programme.desc: School of Golf (Sports). Class is in session with Martin Hall, an award-winning golf teacher who has taught several players on the PGA Tour, Champions Tour and LPGA Tour. Joined by co-host and former «Big Break» champion Blair O'Neal, Martin also answers plenty of viewer emails and incorporates other forms of social media to help drive the show's content

programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season
